tools.name: create_shipment_record
tools.description: Creates a new shipment record with its package details and an initial 'label created' scan event, and returns the new shipment ID and tracking number.

params.name: customer_id
params.description: ID of the customer who owns the shipment

params.name: service_level
params.description: Service level such as ground or express

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone

DATABASE_PATH = "logistics.db"


def create_shipment_record(
    customer_id: int,
    carrier: str,
    origin: str,
    destination: str,
    weight_kg: float,
    service_level: str,
) -> dict:
    created_at_timestamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    generated_tracking_number = "TRK" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:12].upper()
    generated_reference = "SHP-" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:8].upper()
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_PATH)
    cursor = database_connection.cursor()
    cursor.execute(
        "INSERT INTO shipments (reference, tracking_number, customer_id, carrier, origin, destination, status, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'label_created', ?)",
        (generated_reference, generated_tracking_number, customer_id, carrier, origin, destination, created_at_timestamp),
    )
    new_shipment_id = cursor.lastrowid
    cursor.execute(
        "INSERT INTO packages (shipment_id, weight_kg, service_level) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
        (new_shipment_id, weight_kg, service_level),
    )
    cursor.execute(
        "INSERT INTO scan_events (shipment_id, event_time, location, description) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'Label created')",
        (new_shipment_id, created_at_timestamp, origin),
    )
    database_connection.commit()
    database_connection.close()
    return {
        "shipment_id": new_shipment_id,
        "reference": generated_reference,
        "tracking_number": generated_tracking_number,
        "status": "label_created",
    }
